description: This file defines utility methods for working with IntelliJ PSI elements in the context of Android development, including safe access to PSI files, modules, XML tags, and resource references.

classes.name: AndroidPsiUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for PSI and XML handling in Android development within IntelliJ IDEA.

methods.name: getPsiFileSafely
methods.description: Safely retrieves the PsiFile for a given VirtualFile within a Project, acquiring a read lock.

methods.name: getModuleSafely
methods.description: Retrieves the Module containing a given PsiElement, with thread-safe read lock.

methods.name: getModuleSafely
methods.description: Retrieves the Module containing a given VirtualFile within a Project, with thread-safe read lock.

methods.name: getRootTagSafely
methods.description: Returns the root XML tag of an XmlFile, acquiring a read lock if necessary.

methods.name: getRootTagAttributeSafely
methods.description: Safely retrieves the value of a specified attribute from the root tag of an XmlFile.

methods.name: isResourceReference
methods.description: Checks if a PsiElement is a reference to an Android resource.

methods.name: getResourceReferenceType
methods.description: Determines the type of resource reference (APP, FRAMEWORK, or NONE) for a given PsiElement.

methods.name: getResourceName
methods.description: Extracts the resource name from a resource reference PsiElement, e.g., 'foo' from 'R.string.foo'.

methods.name: getResourceReferenceType
methods.description: Determines if a PsiReferenceExpression refers to an Android resource in the app or framework.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the Android ResourceType (e.g., STRING, DRAWABLE) for a resource reference PsiElement.
